notes: R1 (player_tracker_rb) output; historical keys keep their historical meaning; NEW information is under v2.

Target T001 is one logical target for the whole run (D07); target_episode and reacquisition_events record every loss and reacquisition. Only rb_state TRACKING (historical ACTIVE/CONFIRMED_DETECTION) is a trusted, observed identity.

Target bbox = last confirmed (observed) box; observed_position_box = this frame's observed, predicted or held box (D06). v2.observation_source / bbox_is_observed / bbox_is_held / bbox_is_predicted say which.

identity_confidence: v2.identity_confidence_rb when trusted, else <= untrusted_identity_confidence_ceiling (D19). overall_track_confidence = identity_confidence. identity_confidence_rb is UNCALIBRATED.

A reacquisition accepted without beating a confusable competitor (reacquisition_events[].evidence.contrast_verified = false; contrast_available says whether any banked competitor was contrasted) opens an UNVERIFIED episode: its observed boxes are rb_state TRACKING (ACTIVE / CONFIRMED_DETECTION) but identity_trusted = false, reason INSUFFICIENT_CONTRAST, confidence <= 0.49, until a TRACKING frame beats a confusable competitor by the contrast margin. Such an episode never updates the appearance bank.

NEW semantics (not the historical formulas, which are UNKNOWN): appearance_confidence and reid_confidence = composite appearance similarity of the reported box to the target bank (0 if none); motion_confidence = 1 while positional continuity is valid; visibility/position/track_continuity_confidence = 1 only when observed. Population records carry no identity claim (identity_confidence 0; overall_track_confidence = detector score when detected). team = UNKNOWN and team_confidence = 0 everywhere: the generic tracker has no team logic.
Physical-entity exclusion: a population tracklet that is or may be the target this frame is not written as a separate person, and is written as T001 in overlap_contests.

overlap_contests = every overlapping pair of bodies this frame. identity_conflict_counts['T001|Txxx'] = frames in which Txxx was the competing hypothesis that kept the target from being confirmed; identity_conflicts_logged = number of such frames.

spawn_guard_stats is empty and health_metrics provisional_to_confirmed_ratio, duplicate_likelihood, live_association_eligible_dormant_count and pruned_from_live_association_count are null: R1 has no such mechanisms. total_tracks_spawned counts population tracklets (the target's own included).
Wall-clock fields (excluded from the determinism comparison): summary.processing_time_s, summary.v2.provenance.run_started_utc.
